D Complete the passage with suitable words.

The word Pahela means the first and Boishakh is the ________ month of Bangla calendar. The day is observed not ________ in Bangladesh but ________ in some other parts of the world. It is celebrated in West Bengal, Assam and Tripura. It is also ________ in Australia and the UK. In Australia, the largest ________ for Bangla new year is the Sydney Boishakhi Mela held ________ Sydney Olympic Park. In England, the Bangalees ________ celebrate the day with a street ________ in London. It is the ________ Asian festival in Europe, ________ Bangladesh and West Bengal.
